standard_prerequisites.name: Besse contact forms and their Reeb flows
standard_prerequisites.reference: the authors' own account at source lines 963-1042, together with the citations to Kegel-Lange and Cristofaro-Gardiner-Mazzucchelli recorded in the source bibliography

standard_prerequisites.name: Elementary topology of arcs, annuli and constant sections on solid tori
standard_prerequisites.reference: source lines 1043-1085 (the local model) and the rectangles R_i of the proof at source lines 1155-1170
standard_prerequisites.use: The gluing uses explicit arcs, annuli and constant sections together with a greatest common divisor computation; nothing beyond standard surface topology is assumed.

core_obligations: Read off from the Seifert pairs (alpha_j,beta_j) of (Y,lambda_0) the integers alpha = lcm(alpha_2,...,alpha_k), beta, p = beta_1 alpha + alpha_1 beta = -eul(Y) alpha_1 alpha, q = -beta_1' alpha - alpha_1' beta, b = gcd(p,q), p_0 = p/b and q_0 = q/b, and derive the identity alpha = -b p_0/(eul(Y) alpha_1) together with the transversality inequality q_0/p_0 + alpha_1'/alpha_1 = -alpha/(alpha_1 p) < 0 (source lines 1118-1152).

Construct the surface: b many (p_0,q_0)-local surfaces of section inside the solid torus over B_1, alpha distinct constant sections over B_0' after choosing the rectangles R_i, and, on each torus over the boundary of B_i for i at least 2, the extension by the product with an interval that makes the section wind alpha times around f_i and alpha beta_i/alpha_i times around h_i, hence alpha/alpha_i times around m_i and zero times around l_i, allowing extension over B_i as alpha/alpha_i constant sections (source lines 1155-1165).

Prove that the resulting surface of section is connected by identifying the j-th horizontal line over the boundary of B_i with the (j + beta_i alpha/alpha_i)-th one modulo alpha and invoking gcd(alpha, beta_2 alpha/alpha_2, ..., beta_k alpha/alpha_k) = 1, which follows from coprimality of alpha_i with beta_i and from alpha = lcm(alpha_2,...,alpha_k) (source lines 1167-1171).

Verify the three asserted properties of the global surface of section, in particular that its boundary restriction is a covering map of gamma_1 of degree b p_0 and that every regular Reeb orbit in Y minus gamma_1 meets the interior image in exactly alpha points with alpha = -b p_0/(eul(Y) alpha_1) (statement lines 1093-1106).

proof_roadmap.step: Express the Seifert data: dual pairs, alpha, beta, p, q, b, p_0, q_0.
Invert the two linear equations to get -alpha = alpha_1 q + alpha_1' p and beta = beta_1 q + beta_1' p, check the transversality inequality and the formula alpha = -b p_0/(eul(Y) alpha_1).
Glue b local sections inside the torus over B_1 onto alpha constant sections over the base, using the rectangles R_i and the winding numbers alpha and alpha beta_i/alpha_i.
Conclude connectedness from gcd(alpha, beta_2 alpha/alpha_2, ..., beta_k alpha/alpha_k) = 1.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is Theorem 3.1 at source lines 1089-1107, label t:sos_Besse: for a Besse contact 3-manifold with Seifert invariants and a chosen closed Reeb orbit gamma_1 it produces integers b, p_0, q_0, a compact oriented surface with b boundary components and a global surface of section whose boundary restricts to a (p_0,q_0)-local surface of section and which meets every other regular Reeb orbit in exactly alpha = -b p_0/(eul(Y) alpha_1) points. The proof at source lines 1117-1172 is not a verification of a given object: it has to build that surface out of the Seifert data, first introducing the dual Seifert pairs and solving p = beta_1 alpha + alpha_1 beta = -eul(Y) alpha_1 alpha together with q = -beta_1' alpha - alpha_1' beta, then checking the transversality inequality q_0/p_0 + alpha_1'/alpha_1 = -alpha/(alpha_1 p) < 0, then gluing b local sections inside the solid torus over B_1 onto alpha constant sections over the base with prescribed winding alpha beta_i/alpha_i around the fibres, and finally proving connectedness through gcd(alpha, beta_2 alpha/alpha_2, ..., beta_k alpha/alpha_k) = 1. The intersection number, the winding numbers and the connectedness of the resulting surface are coupled through the Seifert invariants and the Euler number, so no routine step yields them; the construction figure at source lines 1109-1115 is invoked three times inside the proof and is delivered with the material.
